summary: Powhatan Court House fire tower site listed as gone by FFLA; no build or staffing record found, and a 2005 eBay sale is noted without a site.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association.

events.note: Eastern US Lookouts page: a 100-foot McClintock-Marshall steel tower was auctioned on eBay and sold for $1,255.00. The page does not name the site, and it sits under the single Powhatan entry.

evidence.supports: FFLA Virginia list: Powhatan (Powhatan Court House), Powhatan County, Tower, Gone, at 37.54759, -77.91298
FFLA Virginia list: Powhatan (Loc 1) entry, also Tower, Gone, at 37.55298, -77.93304 (used for our calculated distance of about 1.9 km)
Eastern US Lookouts Virginia page has one Powhatan tower entry, spelled POWHATTEN
The page notes a 100-foot McClintock-Marshall steel tower auctioned on eBay in 2005 and sold for $1,255.00
evidence.quote: 2005: The 100-foot McClintock-Marshall steel tower was auctioned on ebay and sold for $1,255.00.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA list gives name, county, coordinates and status for both Powhatan entries; the Eastern list has one Powhatan entry (spelled POWHATTEN) and a 2005 eBay note with no site named. The two FFLA entries are about 1.9 km apart by our calculation from their coordinates; they may be two sites or one tower listed twice, and no source here settles it. Searches on McClintock-Marshall and the eBay sale found nothing else. The Towerdex owner page for Powhatan County returned HTTP 403. No NHLR or FFLOS page for this site exists in the local crawl cache. Next steps: Virginia Department of Forestry records; Powhatan County historical society or local newspaper archives for 2005.
